referee_caveats_inferred: The text alternates between a trailing-to-inflowing gas ratio of around 40% and trailing gas being 40% of gas along the bar; the denominator needs clarification.
No missing-flux assessment is given for the 7 m CO observations; this could affect luminosity ratios and relative component fluxes.
The two-component CO decomposition lacks sufficient fitting and selection details to assess robustness independently.
The CO-dark interpretation relies partly on best-fitting broadband SED metallicity rather than a stated independent abundance measurement.
The southern jet-shock interpretation is indirect and is not unique evidence for shock-heated molecular gas.
The conclusion's Compton-thick description is not explicitly reconciled with the reported nuclear absorption fit.
The hardness-ratio footnote labels 0.5–2 keV as hard and 2–8 keV as soft; the intended convention needs clarification.
